product_owner_answers.goal: Keep the signal marker inside a central safe band while deterministic disturbances push it horizontally.
product_owner_answers.controls: Left/Right arrows and A/D steer. P or Escape pauses/resumes. Enter restarts after game over; an on-screen restart control is also required.
product_owner_answers.lives: Start with three lives. Remaining outside the safe band continuously for 750ms loses one life, recenters the signal, and grants 800ms grace before another loss.
product_owner_answers.score: Score increases by one per survived second while playing, not while paused or after game over.
product_owner_answers.difficulty: Disturbance strength increases gradually with survived time but remains deterministic for a supplied seed and sequence of time steps.
product_owner_answers.state_model: Core state updates accept explicit input and delta time, clamp an individual delta to 100ms, and do not read wall-clock time or DOM APIs.
product_owner_answers.responsive: Canvas fits 390x844 and desktop without page overflow; game coordinates remain stable as CSS size changes.
product_owner_answers.accessibility: Canvas has an accessible name, instructions and live score/lives text exist outside the bitmap, controls are keyboard reachable, and pause is obvious when focus is lost.

acceptance.criterion: Keyboard steering changes deterministic core state in the correct direction; disturbance for the same seed and dt sequence is repeatable.
Continuous 750ms outside the band removes exactly one of three lives, recenters, and enforces 800ms grace.
Score advances only during active play at one point per survived second; pause and game over freeze it.
P/Escape and visible control pause/resume; blur pauses; Enter and visible restart create a fresh deterministic initial state after game over.
Core update is DOM-free, accepts explicit dt/input, clamps dt to 100ms, and has automated tests for repeatability and lifecycle edges.
Desktop and 390x844 render without page overflow; score, lives, state, and instructions remain readable outside the canvas.
Production build succeeds and the handoff documents controls, install, test, and build commands.

robustness: Held keys release on keyup and blur, avoiding stuck steering.
Large frame gaps cannot skip multiple lives because dt is clamped and grace is enforced.
Restart clears timers, input, score, lives, and pause/game-over flags.
game_review: The player can understand goal and danger without reading source.
Motion, feedback, and hierarchy feel intentional rather than default canvas primitives.
Pause, damage, and game-over states are immediately distinguishable.
